preservedResponsibilities: Original ICU78.3 chnsecal.cpp astronomical day conversions, solstice/new-moon caches, month information and new-year search. Source constants and approximation branches are unchanged.
omittedResponsibilities: Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Split the original source responsibility into a TypeScript fragment while retaining the actual source owner, to satisfy file-size and ESM initialization constraints.
